locator.name: lists the seven changes first, selects each and the second family by its row with one read each, and keeps the first family

locator.name: tags a kept family, describes the subject it was read for, and reads one answer for the selected family

proves.facet: The kept tag sits on its family row with last-read subject title; the row owns its accessible description. The selected subject slot contains only its family review, provenance retains its read label and no kept tag enters the reading column.

locator.name: keeps the first family when its second family is clicked, and its shared member row selects it under the first family

proves.facet: Clicking the second family retains the complete first family; clicking its shared member row then selects that first-family occurrence.
